race.description: Spring Racing Carnival Book Now Mdn Plate (Set Weights)
race.comment: BUDDA BAR (8) settled back from a wide draw on debut at Eagle Farm, and hit the line strongly out wide to finish runner-up by a length and a half. He cops a superior gate this time, and maps to race closer to the pace, so we have him on top. ASTERN EFFORT (1) probably should have won a race by now, and he should do this season after winning his last 2 trials very impressively. He benefits from a 1.5kg claim, and from a handy gate, he can break his duck fresh up. ESNAAD (10) has 3 provincial grade placings from 3 starts in Sydney, and treks north to be perfectly placed to break through with 1.5kg less to carry. Ben Thompson in the saddle is a strong lead, and she will be hard to hold out. STELLAGRACIA (6) makes her debut off the back of a couple of sound trial efforts on this track. A good draw, and a 3kg claim, will ensure that she is well found in the markets. Each way. MISS CHAMONIX (5) resumes from a spell, and her only placing came on this track. Keep safe from the ace gate.
